reviews.evidence: Full source constructs TM from tangent spaces and coordinate charts; vector-bundle, local-trivialization, and smooth-atlas were consequences of the construction and removed from its minimal prerequisites.
Full source defines a form as a smooth section of an exterior power of the cotangent bundle; tangent space, cotangent bundle, exterior power, and section are direct foundations.
Full source requires a Lie group, smooth total/base manifolds, a surjective submersion, a smooth action, and equivariant local diffeomorphisms; current prerequisites match these ingredients.
Full source defines R_g by group multiplication and derives its differential; the diffeomorphism group is only a later target of the family and was removed from prerequisites.
Full source obtains transition maps by composing local trivializations on overlaps; smooth bundle, typical fiber, diffeomorphism, smooth map, and local trivialization are direct.
Full source defines the kernel of dπ for a fibered manifold and identifies it with vertical tangent spaces; current prerequisites cover the kernel, tangent, and subbundle constructions.
